name: Mutexium
description: It seems as though only one entity can hold this piece of raw mutexium at any one time. How did you get your hands on this?

name: Semaphorite
description: It emits light with a color that oscillates periodically. Bringing two pieces together will cause their glow to synchronize without fail.

name: Actorisite
description: Each fragment seems to process its own impulses independently, yet when placed nearby they exchange tiny bursts of energy as though passing messages to coordinate.
